name: rune_gravecaller_grasp
for: gravecaller 'grasp' (fight.rs GRAVECALLER, area attack, AREA_HALF 1.1 m)
notes: A patch of disturbed grave soil (~130 px = 2.2 m across, the hit patch) churns on the ground with pale grave-mist motes and twitching clods (frames 1-12, faint first), then frame 13 erupts: dirt and soul wisps burst up and five hand-pixelled dead hands claw up out of the soil (frames 14-17), clench (18-20) and sink back (21-23). Anchor = the patch centre on the ground. 24 frames @ 12 fps.
